rows.name: Dundalk
rows.description: Red screw piles in entrance. Bright lt. seaward from E. to S. ½ E.; thence masked over Dunany Reefs to S.S.W. ½ W.; thence red over S.W. banks to N.N.W. ¼ W. Bright lt. to channel, but masked from N. ¾ W. to E., over N.W. sandbanks. Fog-bell 6 str. a min.

rows.name: LOUGH CARLINGFORD
rows.character: 1. Two bright fixed lts. 2. Two br. fixed leading lights 3. One br. rev. lt. ½ m. 4. Red Pier light
rows.description: 1. In one tower, 111 ft. high, on Haulbowline Rock. Lower lt. from half flood to half ebb A small red light shown to N.E. Bell 2. Two iron pile lighthouses, ¾ mile N. by W. from No. 1, 500 yards apart. In one N.N.W. ¼ W. lead through new cut in 15 ft. 3. On Greenore Point 4. On Greenore Pier

rows.name: DUNDRUM BAY
rows.description: On St. John's Point. Red 45 secs., dark 15 secs. Shaded across the bay to N. of W. by N. ½ N.

rows.name: Ardglass Harbour
rows.description: One fixed red light at its head

rows.name: SOUTH ROCK LT.-VES.
rows.description: Supersedes S. Rock lt.-ho., and shows revol. lt. every 1½ min. In 30 fms., 1 mile E. of Ridge Shoal. Fog-gun every ½ hour

rows.name: Donaghadee
rows.character: One red or br. fixed lt.
rows.description: On pier-head. Red to seaward, from S.S.E. to N.E.; br. lt. obscured betw. S. ½ E. & shore

rows.name: COPELAND
rows.description: A white tower, 52 ft. high, on Small Copeland Island. Fog-bell

rows.name: Belfast Bay
rows.description: Pile lt.ho., with red lt., on Hollywood Bank; green lt., also on the Bank; 3 more green lts. towards Belfast; and a red lt. S.W. of Stone Beacon Fog-bell

rows.name: Larne Lough
rows.description: One bright lt. on Farrs Point. A sector of red light is now shown over the reef off Barr Point, and over the Hunter Rock, to between E.N.E. and N.E. by E.

rows.name: MAIDENS
rows.description: Towers, 76 and 68 ft. high, white, with red belt. In one, N.W. by W., 800 yds. apart

rows.name: RATHLIN
rows.description: Tower, 88 ft. high, with red belt, on Altacarry or N.E. point. Upper lt. intermit., br. 50 secs.; dark, 10 secs. Shown northward, from N.W. ½ N. to S.E. by S., and to S. on Rathlin Island, from S.W. by W. ½ W. to W. ½ S. Red lt. over Carrickvanan Rock. Lower fixed lt. does not show in Rathlin Sound. A fog-gun every 15 minutes

rows.name: Inishowen
rows.description: E. tower, 49 ft.; W. tower, 74 ft. On Dunagree Point. In one, West, 153 yds. apart. A red sector from W. tower, 25 ft. below br. lt. over Tuns Bank, from E.S.E. to S.E. ½ E.

rows.name: Warren Point
rows.description: Red to S betw. W. by S. ½ S. & E. ½ N.; white seaward from E. ½ N. towards land, and up Lough Foyle from W. by S. ½ S. to W. ½ S.

rows.name: Red Castle
rows.description: On red piles, on outer edge of Ridge Shoal

rows.name: White Castle
rows.description: On black piles, East side of channel

rows.name: Ture
rows.description: On black piles, S.E. side of channel

rows.name: Cunnyberry
rows.description: On red piles, N.W. side of channel
